integrity: All displayed exact formulas are derived from the explicit rectangular incidence matrix and rank/Jordan calculations. Two standalone standard-library checks were rerun and their actual outputs included. No independent external audit has been performed.
limitations: The proof is for an unweighted single missing incidence in an otherwise complete subdivision of K_n (n>=3), synchronous open-neighbor addition over finite characteristic-two fields. No general graph, odd characteristic, or second-fault claim is made. Finite verification is supportive rather than an infinite proof. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed equivalents.
title: A broken incidence creates fourteen-phase clocks and seven-step transients in subdivided cliques
